# Siliguri Fresh Mart

> Premium fresh fish, chicken, mutton, vegetables and essentials delivered to your doorstep in Siliguri in 30 minutes. Free delivery above ₹299.

## About
Siliguri Fresh Mart is a quick-commerce grocery delivery service based in Siliguri, West Bengal, India. We deliver fresh fish, chicken, mutton, pork, seafood, vegetables, fruits, dairy and daily essentials within 30 minutes.

## Categories
- [Fresh Fish](https://www.siligurifreshmart.com/category/fish): Rohu, Katla, Pabda, Bhetki, Tangra and more — daily fresh from local markets
- [Chicken](https://www.siligurifreshmart.com/category/chicken): Farm-fresh broiler and country chicken, cut to order
- [Mutton](https://www.siligurifreshmart.com/category/mutton): Premium goat mutton, curry cut and keema
- [Vegetables](https://www.siligurifreshmart.com/category/vegetables): Seasonal and organic vegetables
- [Fruits](https://www.siligurifreshmart.com/category/fruits): Fresh seasonal fruits
- [Dairy & Eggs](https://www.siligurifreshmart.com/category/dairy): Milk, curd, paneer, eggs
- [Groceries](https://www.siligurifreshmart.com/category/groceries): Rice, dal, oil, spices and daily essentials

## Delivery Info
- Delivery time: 30 minutes
- Delivery area: Within Siliguri city limits
- Free delivery on orders above ₹299
- Delivery fee: ₹59 (below ₹99), ₹40 (₹99-₹298), Free (₹299+)
- Payment: Cash on Delivery (COD), UPI (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm)
